description: Today's hiking call for Puerto Rico's trails, as 787daily's /hike/ shows it: for El Yunque National Forest or the trails around the island, the area's call and each trail's (good, fair, poor or closed) for the next days (three days for the whole area; one trail adds the readings behind its call), from USGS rain gauges, National Weather Service alerts and the forecast. A reading of public data, not a safety guarantee; trail closures are the managing agency's. Cite 787daily.com/hike/.
